GlobalFoundries outlines FDX Fusion for physical AI

The roadmap targets evaluation silicon in 2027 and manufacturing in 2028.

GlobalFoundries ↗9 October 2026English editorial summary
Story

A platform in development

GlobalFoundries positions FDX Fusion for sensing, computation, action and communication in robotics and automation, with Dresden manufacturing planned for 2028.

Integration goals

FD-SOI combines digital, analog, radio-frequency and memory functions. The company targets 7nm-class digital performance; that wording does not identify a literal 7nm process node.

Milestones ahead

Demonstrator silicon is targeted for early 2027 and an initial design kit for mid-year. Efficiency and performance remain roadmap targets rather than measured silicon results.
